gallery.title: Abyssal Ascent
gallery.description: Hatch in the vent-lit cradle ten kilometres down and devour your way up through seven depth zones, evolving ten times over — larva, ribbon eel, viperfish, gulper, sea serpent, bone shark, leviathan, and finally The Kraken. The residents fight back: octopuses blind you with ink, rays discharge, anglerfish reel you in, orcas and sperm whales hunt you on sight. Reach the surface as a kraken and the fishing fleet stops being a hazard and starts being food — until they send something with a thicker hull.
